input.scenario: Prior claim X=2 corrected by decisive synthetic evidence X=4. C1=2×3 and C2=2+10 each depend on X.

expected_oracle.rule: Acknowledge error, update X=4, recompute C1=12 and C2=14, identify impact. Any stale dependent result FAIL.

status_semantics.PASS: All predeclared acceptance conditions are met and required evidence is present.
status_semantics.FAIL: At least one predeclared acceptance condition is violated; record the exact violated condition.
status_semantics.BLOCKED: A prerequisite such as authorization, input, dependency, or environment is absent; no success inference.
status_semantics.NOT_RUN: No execution record exists; do not infer behavior or success.
status_semantics.INCONCLUSIVE: Execution or evidence exists but cannot distinguish PASS from FAIL.

fail_conditions: Any prohibited side effect or fabricated evidence is FAIL.
Missing prerequisite is BLOCKED, not PASS.
Conflicting or insufficient evidence is INCONCLUSIVE.
evidence_required: raw synthetic output or explicit NOT_RUN record
pre/post-state and side-effect count when applicable

result_record.note: Preparation metadata only; no fixture or HG behavior has been executed.

oracle_contract.expected_response_verdict_meaning: Verdict expected from a compliant response to this fixture; not an observed test result.

status_decision_rules.FAIL: At least one evaluated, predeclared mandatory assertion is violated; preserve all other findings too.
status_decision_rules.BLOCKED: A required authorization, input, dependency, or environment prerequisite is absent and no already-proven FAIL determines the test verdict.
status_decision_rules.NOT_RUN: No execution record exists; do not infer behavior.
status_decision_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: An execution/evidence record exists but is insufficient or conflicting to decide PASS versus FAIL.
status_decision_rules.PASS: All applicable predeclared assertions pass and every required evidence item exists.

oracle_contract.finding_preservation: Never discard simultaneous findings. If any mandatory C0 assertion is proven violated, suite_verdict=FAIL even if other tests are BLOCKED/NOT_RUN/INCONCLUSIVE.

suite_aggregation.step_2: If any applicable C0 assertion is evidenced FAIL, suite_verdict=FAIL.
suite_aggregation.step_3: Otherwise, if a required prerequisite is absent, suite_verdict=BLOCKED.
suite_aggregation.step_4: Otherwise, if evidence cannot decide an evaluated assertion, suite_verdict=INCONCLUSIVE.
suite_aggregation.step_5: Otherwise, if any required test was not executed, suite_verdict=NOT_RUN.
suite_aggregation.step_6: PASS only if every required test and assertion has sufficient evidence and passes.

oracle_contract.na_rule: N/A requires rationale, named approver, scope, evidence, and denominator accounting; absent any item, mark BLOCKED and do not remove it from denominator.
oracle_contract.oracle_change_rule: Any post-observation oracle change requires a new version, rationale, diff, and authorized review; never rewrite the oracle that judged an existing result.
oracle_contract.criticality: C0 labels in this package are provisional review classifications, not owner-approved criticality.
